title: Fourier coefficient
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and a set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, its Fourier coefficient at $S$ is the uniform average $\mathbb{E}_{x\in\{-1,1\}^n}\left[f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i\right]$.
